payload.title: Salt Lake City Plumber
payload.description: Copper Eagle Plumbing fixes drains, water heaters, gas lines and more for homes in Salt Lake City and nearby Utah cities. Call or text to book a visit.

hero.heading: Life’s too short to worry about your home’s plumbing.
hero.body: We do it all, and we do it right. From fixing broken or clogged drains to upgrading your water filtration systems, or even complete remodels, we can tackle it all. Let us help by fixing all of your plumbing problems so you can get back to doing what you love.

image.alt: Kitchen with white cabinets, a pull-down faucet and a green tile backsplash

introduction.heading: Finally, a master plumber in Utah you can trust.
introduction.body: In today’s world, it can be tough to find a skilled plumber who is dedicated to the highest degree of quality. At Copper Eagle Plumbing in Salt Lake City, Utah, we are dedicated to our craft. We use the highest quality parts and materials combined with the utmost degree of accuracy and commitment to detail.

image.alt: Jordan Walker, Master Plumber in Utah Salt Lake City

items.quote: He got to the bottom of the hot water and low pressure issues I was having with my guest bathroom sink and shower, and was able to fix them the same day (I had thought that it would have taken several days). Great service!
items.author: Josh G.
items.title: "Jordan was terrific!"

items.quote: Jordan Walker showed me how to maintain my sink and tub stoppers. Was super helpful to tell me things that I can do on my own. He also changed my water softener level. He changed the shower cartridge so that the shower wouldn’t just be hot. Last week he cleaned, drained and replaced heating elements in my rental unit hot water heater.
items.author: Grace M.
items.title: "Jordan is super friendly, timely and knowledgeable.”
Done right every time.
items.body: With over 10 years of plumbing experience, our work is 100% guaranteed so you can rest easy knowing you have the best.

items.title: Fair and honest pricing.
items.body: With Copper Eagle, you won’t get taken for a ride. We’re honest and upfront with all of our pricing so you know exactly what to expect.

image.alt: Fair and Honest Affordable Plumber in Utah

items.title: Licensed and insured.
items.body: We use the latest techniques to ensure all our plumbing services are up to code. Master plumbing license number: UT- 9495287-5518.

image.alt: Licensed and Insured Plumber in Utah

service-areas.heading: PLUMBING SERVICES FOR LOCAL UTAH AREAS

help-prompt.heading: What can we help you with?

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: We were contacted by a customer experiencing issues with their water heater. We quickly identified that the problem was due to a leak on their 75-gallon water heater. We promptly replaced it with a high-quality model, a state 75-gallon water heater. We encountered a few obstacles along the way, but we prevailed and managed to restore their hot water supply the very same day. We take pride in our ability to deliver swift solutions, no matter the challenges we encounter. Another job well done by our team, ensuring our customer's comfort and satisfaction.

photos.alt: Two gas water heaters side by side in a basement after the replacement
Combustion analyzer reading at the new water heater
Testing the draft at the water heater's flue with a combustion analyzer

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: This gas line install was tight due to the duct in the way. either way we were able to come and get the job done. this gas line will be to update a fireplace in park city. next step, inspection

photos.alt: New black gas line run along a framed wall to the fireplace
Gas line routed past a duct inside the wall

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: Today, we had the privilege of meeting with key community business owners. They reached out to us seeking a capable team to provide exceptional ongoing services. Our strength lies not just in building, but in maintaining, which is no small task. We leveraged our skills: astute listening and humility, to fully understand their needs. In response, we provided a comprehensive approach tailored to their business objectives. As always, we're excited to use our expertise to help our community thrive.

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: Copper Eagle Plumbing is proud to serve Salt Lake City and surrounding Utah communities with honest, professional, and affordable plumbing services. As a locally owned company, our team takes pride in delivering dependable workmanship and treating every customer with respect. From plumbing repairs and remodels to water heaters, gas lines, and custom home plumbing, we focus on quality work done right the first time. We believe in clear communication, fair pricing, and building long-term relationships through trust and reliability. Whether you need a quick repair or a large plumbing project completed, Copper Eagle Plumbing is ready to help keep your home running smoothly with clean, professional service you can count on.

items.author: Spencer Kaiserman
items.body: At this property, they had multiple leaks along their drain lines. Luckily their plumbing systems were mostly accessible through the crawl space. That allowed us to come in and repipe the entire guts of the drainage system to update it to ABS from the old Cast Iron piping. The customer was really appreciative of our work and helping them fix their plumbing problems long term!

photos.alt: New ABS drain line under the floor joists in a crawl space
ABS drain pipe running along the crawl space wall
ABS drain stack and fittings under the floor
Long run of new ABS drain pipe across the crawl space
New ABS drain lines joining under the house

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: I will install the Roughin on the new quartz deckin and leave lengths of pipe long enough to reach the crawlspace to make connection.we added 2 hose bibs and repiped a portion of the house to get it ready for a softener. 84526

photos.alt: Remodeled bathroom with a soaking tub and vanity
Brass tub filler and shower valve on a tiled wall

items.author: Holden Reynolds
items.body: Installed a new garbage disposal. Old one was leaking out the bottom. Installed it and it works great now and the lady was very happy to have a new one that worked and didn’t leak anymore

photos.alt: New garbage disposal installed under a kitchen sink

items.author: Dalton Reynolds
items.body: Had a valve that someone reversed the hot and cold connections on. With this valve I was able to flip the cartridge and get it working how it should.

photos.alt: Shower valve exposed through an access hole in the tile
Close-up of the shower valve cartridge
Shower valve with the cartridge flipped and reinstalled
Shower valve body between the hot and cold supply lines

items.author: Matt Hibler
items.body: We were contacted by the client to address a problematic situation with a broken toilet tank, which had resulted in water flooding out. To solve the issue, we replaced the broken tank with a new toilet and carried out a thorough water cleanup operation. We're glad to have been able to quickly and professionally restore full functionality to the customer's restroom while also eliminating any potential water damage. Having a working toilet is a necessity and we're proud to be able to provide this essential service. As always, we strive to ensure our clients' satisfaction with our products and services.

photos.alt: Broken toilet tank on the bathroom floor
Toilet flange exposed after the old toilet came out
New toilet installed in the bathroom

items.author: Matt Hibler
items.body: We were contacted about a Rheem water heater that was intermittently showing a code 7. We diagnosed the challenge as a fault with the gas control and chamber temperature sensor. So, we got a new gas control and sensor, then proceeded to drain the water heater before replacing these parts. Additionally, we noticed a slow leak from the temperature and pressure relief valve. We removed the old valve and installed a new one. The replacements and adjustments now guarantee a smooth and safer functioning water heater. Your comfort and safety is always our priority!

photos.alt: Rheem gas water heater after the gas control was replaced
Water heater gas control above a floor drain
Rating label and warning sticker on the water heater

items.author: Matt Hibler
items.body: Our team was contacted to address an outdated water heater. To provide a proficient solution, we will drain, disconnect, and dispose of the old equipment. The replacement will be a brand new, efficient Rheem 50 gallon water heater that operates on natural gas. The inclusive installation procedure will comply with all the necessary codes. By opting for this hot water solution, we ensure the customer experiences a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and energy efficiency.

photos.alt: Old water heater in a brick basement corner
New Rheem 50-gallon gas water heater installed in the corner
Venting and expansion tank above the new water heater

items.author: Matt Hibler
items.body: The customer contacted us due to an issue with their water heater which had broken and required replacement. We're tasked with maintaining the balance of providing excellent service while keeping the warranty intact. As a solution to the client's problem, we used a new water heater, ensuring the installation was done with utmost professionalism and within the warranty's guidelines. Our aim was to offer a seamless service experience, surpassing the client's expectations while replacing their broken water heater. As always, the satisfaction of our customers is our highest priority. We're pleased to have brought warmth back into the customer's home while adhering to the warranty's terms and conditions.

photos.alt: Two water heaters side by side under the floor joists
Water heaters and their vent pipes in a utility room
New water heater beside the washing machine
Gas line and vent connections on top of the new water heater

items.author: Matt Hibler
items.body: We were recently contacted by a client who was dealing with issues with their water heater. The main problem was that their water heater needed to be relit, and it required a new thermocouple. We understood the importance of a well-functioning water heater, especially during these cold months. After carefully diagnosing the problem, we replaced the thermocouple and relit the water heater using our best quality products and employing our expertise in the field. We always strive to keep our customers satisfied by delivering efficient solutions to their problems.

photos.alt: Water heater gas control valve after the new thermocouple
Pilot flame burning behind the water heater's sight glass
Gas water heater in a basement after relighting

items.author: Matt Hibler
items.body: When running water the tub would drain very slow immediately.

photos.alt: Drain cable lowered into a slow tub drain
Drain camera screen showing the inside of the tub drain
Drain camera view further down the line

items.author: Matt Hibler
items.body: Our team at copper eagle plumbing was recently contacted by a client who had a leak in a copper pipe in their home. Understanding the urgency of the situation, we responded promptly to provide our service. Employing our experience and professional skills, we successfully fixed the leak, using a new copper pipe and soldering it in place where the old one was. We're pleased to have once again provided prompt and efficient service, resolving our client's issue with minimal disruption. Ensuring customer satisfaction is our top priority and we strive diligently to maintain the standard of our service.

photos.alt: Leaking copper pipe beside a water-damaged wall
Copper pipe and shutoff valve at the leak
Gloved hand fitting a new section of copper pipe
Repaired copper pipe soldered in place
New PVC water lines connected at the bottom of a dug trench
Trench in the lawn with the new PVC lines in place

items.author: Holden Reynolds
items.body: The customer reached out to us because their water felt hard and they were interested in exploring softening options. We offered the best solution to their problem - a Sentry 2 water softener. This product is highly efficient for eliminating hardness in water and provides them with soft water supply in their home. Their trust in us to deliver the right solution to soften their water supply truly speaks to our commitment to customer satisfaction. We are pleased to have provided a tailored solution to their unique water softening needs. Great cooperation all around.

photos.alt: Sentry water softener and brine tank in a utility room

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: Our team was contacted by a customer in need of a practical upgrade for one of their 50 gallon water heaters. Their aim was to enhance efficiency, while maintaining the same level of service. To achieve this, we installed the highly efficient Navien 240A tankless water heater. We not only replaced the old heater, but also performed essential modifications that included upscaling the gas, installing a new flue vent, and opening the walkway for easier accessibility. All these steps were taken to ensure not just the efficiency of the new system, but also the safety and convenience of our customer. Our solution not only meets their current needs, but also is poised to deliver reliable service for years to come.

photos.alt: Navien tankless water heater mounted on the wall with new gas and water lines
Tankless water heater with its new yellow gas line and venting

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: The customer reached out to us when they noticed their boiler was leaking, we then noticed it was fluctuating intermittently. We were able to identify that the issue was stemming from their indirect storage tank which was improperly allowing water to cross between the systems. This was a tough challenge to pinpoint, but we are experts in troubleshooting tricky problems. After inspecting the situation, we shared a pricing structure for correcting the problem. Now the customer is fully informed and ready to take the next steps. We appreciate the trust placed in us and will return to deliver our best.

photos.alt: Boiler and indirect storage tank in a mechanical room
Circulator pump and piping on the indirect storage tank
Brass valve and red circulator pump on the boiler piping
Pressure gauge reading on the boiler system

items.author: Holden Reynolds
items.body: Our team responded to a customer's request for a water heater change out today. After considering various options, the customer elected to install a 75 Gallon Rheem water heater. We were able to provide a quick, efficient installation service, ensuring the customer's comfort and satisfaction. Another successful service experience made possible by our reliable Rheem Water Heaters.

photos.alt: New 75-gallon Rheem water heater

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: We were recently contacted by a customer experiencing issues with a leaking solder joint and a clogged sink supply line. To address the leaking solder joint, we replaced the fitting, ultimately stopping the leak. Tackling the problem with the clogged sink supply line, we efficiently removed the obstruction, restoring the sink's functionality. We're always here to provide solutions to our customers’ plumbing problems promptly and effectively.

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: Our team was contacted after a customer experienced an unfortunate accident, resulting in a cracked toilet tank. Responding quickly, we installed an American Standard Cadet Pro toilet - a top-quality, comfort height model that perfectly suited their needs. Upon further inspection, we noticed the shutoff valve was leaking. We immediately took care of this, ensuring a solid, leak-free system. And just because we believe in going the extra mile, we shoveled their walkways as a courtesy. Now they can enjoy a secure, fresh bathroom once more.

photos.alt: Cracked toilet tank set in the tub after removal
New American Standard toilet installed

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: The customer contacted us about an outdated plug that needed replacement. We swiftly responded by manufacturing a custom-made plug in our own facility. This service eliminated the need for the customer to endure a disruptive floor jackhammering and underground replacement process. Our customized plug not only resolved the issue but considerably saved costs. We're glad that our unique in-house solutions could lead to such successful results.

photos.alt: Custom-made plug fitted in a floor drain

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: The customer reached out due to a ruptured expansion tank that had filled with water, a kinked cold water flex on the water heater, and a clogged aerator in their upstairs bathroom. Our team provided fast and proficient service, replacing the damaged expansion tank, fixing the kinked cold water flex, and successfully unclogging and replacing the aerator in the upstairs bathroom. Our top-quality equipment and expert techniques were applied to ensure the issue was solved efficiently and effectively.

photos.alt: New expansion tank on the water heater piping

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: The customer approached us with concerns about maintaining their tankless water heater. Aware that regular flushing extends the lifespan of their equipment and secures its warranty, they reached out to us for our standout service. We promptly offered a non-invasive tankless water heater flush, a not very costly procedure that's highly beneficial for the unit. During the process, we used Flow Aide, a top-quality product, ensuring optimal performance of the heater. In acknowledgment of the customer having multiple issues, we gladly offered our discount, emphasizing our dedication to excellent service.

photos.alt: Pump in a bucket flushing a tankless water heater
Flushing solution in the bucket during the tankless flush

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: After being contacted by our customer regarding an issue with their plumbing, we promptly provided our service to address the problem. Our team utilized quality products in achieving a solution - a Fluidmaster fill valve and a Korky flapper, renowned for their reliability. We were successful in replacing the flapper and fill valve, ensuring they were free of leaks and working efficiently. We are pleased to have resolved our customer's issue, demonstrating our commitment to delivering first-rate plumbing solutions.

photos.alt: Fluidmaster fill valve ready to install

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: Our valued customer reached out to us due to issues with their outdated water heater. It didn't make sence to fix the broken burner assbly, We stepped in promptly to provide a solution. We executed a tricky lift during installation, not a task for the faint-hearted, but our team was up to the challenge! The replacement unit we installed was a top-notch Rheem professional water heater, known for its durability and efficiency. Due to the house's water pressure, we also installed a Watts expansion tank to prevent damaging pressure build-ups and ensure efficiency. The customer's satisfaction is our team's greatest reward. We stay committed to providing reliable, top-quality service!

photos.alt: New Rheem water heater with a Watts expansion tank

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: We were contacted by a customer in Park City due to the absence of hot water at their property. Following an evaluation, we diagnosed the problem to be a low pressure in the system which had no straightforward solution to replenish it. To rectify this, we successfully installed a port which would allow for the system to be filled. In the process, we relied on the dependability of Pex, Watts, and Viega products. We are pleased to have been able to resolve this issue promptly, ensuring our customer was not left in the cold for too long.

photos.alt: Boiler controller display showing a 112 degree target
Heating control panels on the mechanical room wall
Radiant heat manifold with red and blue PEX lines
Boiler storage tank with a temperature gauge

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: Our team was contacted by a home owner who required extensive renovations including a complete replumbing of their rustic cabin. Renovation is our specialty, and we approached the task meticulously, ensuring all water and drain lines were handled with utmost care. The project included the installation of a new bathroom, laundry, kitchen, and a mechanical room. To deliver top-tier quality and service, we leveraged the superior functionality and durability of pex, abs, and Moen products. We are pleased to report that yet another location has benefited from our comprehensive remodeling services.

photos.alt: Cabin interior framed for the new bathroom, laundry and kitchen
Framed cabin walls with new plumbing roughed in
New water line running through the crawl space under the cabin
New drain lines under the cabin floor
Drain stack under the cabin floor

items.author: Spencer Kaiserman
items.body: Did a toilet rebuild in Millcreek today! It was constantly filling because the fill valve had gone bad. We love to help out our neighbors!

photos.alt: Toilet tank with a new fill valve

items.author: Spencer Kaiserman
items.body: We just roughed in for a free-standing tub and added to the existing plumbing for an older home here in Salt Lake City. The owner is remodeling the downstairs basement and after our work they are ready for the next phase of the remodel!

photos.alt: Drain rough-in for a freestanding tub in a basement floor

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: The customer reached out to us seeking an estimate for the installation of a softener, aiming to protect their tankless water heater along with other appliances and fixtures in the home. We responded with a proposal that considered their specific needs and circumstances. To tackle the job, we will be utilizing the efficient and reliable Century II water softener. In assessing the situation, we also observed that several pipes in the home required securing. This is an essential step not only for immediate functionality but for the long-term health of the household's plumbing system. We look forward to using our expertise to ensure the most valuable solution for the customer's needs.

photos.alt: Tankless water heater on a utility room wall
Water pipes in a utility closet

items.author: Dalton Reynolds
items.body: Doing a little drain work and installing a new tub during a plumbing remodel.

photos.alt: New tub set in place during a bathroom remodel

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: We are Mr. Steam certified. We are the premiere option for other Steam shower brands aswell. When a residential or commercial unit needs cleaning or service, Mr. Steam will call us directly to help get it back in working shape. We have worked with Amerec, Steamist, Steam spa and Thermosol

photos.alt: Hallway outside a glass steam shower door
Technician working beside a steam generator
Electrical panel serving the steam unit

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: Community outreach, we taught the local kindergarden school about motion in 3 directions and rotation (like the wheels on a bus) we had fun sharing how 3d printers work and how we can explain things in X-Y-Z directions. All of the kiddos got a copper eagle fidget toy and a little gyro toy.

photos.alt: Classroom whiteboard with motion diagrams beside a 3D printer

items.author: Jordan Walker
items.body: We were recently contacted by a client who was experiencing issues with their tub drain. Seemingly, the drainage was slower than it should have been and it was causing inconvenience for the customer. In response, we stepped in to professionally clean the problematic tub drain, which enhanced the overall flow. However, we noted that the drain and overflow pieces were worn out and, hence, needed replacement. Fortunately, the customer had earlier supplied these parts and we proceeded to install them. Now, the tub is back in perfect working condition, draining efficiently and smoothly. We're glad we could provide a hand!

photos.alt: Tub with its new drain and overflow trim
Matte black tub spout above the new drain
